public sealed partial class Repo<T> : IRepo<T>, IDisposable where T : class, new()
{

    public string Name { get; init; } = "x{";

    public T this[int i] { get => default!; set { } }

        [FromQuery] string? filter = null)
    {
        if (id > 0) { return Ok(); }
        foreach (var x in _items) { Console.WriteLine($"{x.Key} {{literal}} {(id > 1 ? "a" : "b")}"); }
        using (var s = new MemoryStream()) { }
        lock (_items) { }
        try { } catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException) { }
        Func<int, int> sq = v => { return v * v; };
        void Local() { }
        return Ok();
    }
    public (int a, string b) Tuple() => (1, "b");
    public IEnumerable<TOut> Map<TOut>(Func<T, TOut> f) where TOut : struct => throw new NotImplementedException();
    void IDisposable.Dispose() { }
    public static Repo<T> operator +(Repo<T> a, Repo<T> b) => a;

    enum State { A = 1, B = A << 1 }
